subject: Patrick Clerkin City Council Campaign Statement
overview: Candidate Patrick Clerkin delivers a statement regarding his run for City Council, focusing on his vision for community unity and improved local governance.

items.title: Campaign Statement of Patrick Clerkin
items.summary: Patrick Clerkin outlines his platform for the City Council, advocating for a balanced budget, support for public safety and educators, and a move away from political fragmentation toward community reconciliation.
